title: Louisiana-Style Mild Rémoulade
description: Smoked paprika, mustard and sweet roasted pepper turn a smooth chilled emulsion into a mild Louisiana-style seafood sauce.
equipment: Vitamix or immersion blender with tall heatproof jug

ingredients.name: plain full-fat mayonnaise
ingredients.note: Use pasteurized mayonnaise at about 90 mg sodium per tablespoon. Low-sodium batch: use 2 tbsp total.

ingredients.name: no-salt-added low-fat cottage cheese
ingredients.note: Use a no-salt-added product at about 45 mg sodium per 1/2 cup.

ingredients.name: peeled roasted red bell pepper
ingredients.note: Plain home-roasted pepper with skin and seeds removed.

steps.title: Blend the creamy base
steps.text: Blend {cot}, {sc} and {may} until completely smooth, about 30 seconds.

steps.title: Season the remoulade
steps.text: Add {bell}, {ms}, {pa}, {le}, {par} and {dryga}. Blend again until the pepper and parsley are fully incorporated.

steps.title: Rest the seasonings
steps.text: Cover and chill for 30 minutes so the ground mustard softens and the flavors settle.

steps.title: Set the yield
steps.text: Transfer to a measuring cup. Adjust to 1 cup, adding sodium-free water a teaspoon at a time if short. The finished sauce should cling to a spoon.

steps.title: Serve the sauce
steps.text: Serve chilled with tender shrimp, fish or warm potatoes. Pass extra smoked paprika separately.

notes: Yield: 1 cup, or four 1/4-cup portions. Low-sodium option for the full batch: Use 2 tbsp plain full-fat mayonnaise in place of 5 tbsp. Use 6 tbsp reduced-fat cultured sour cream in place of 3 tbsp. Use the same final 1-cup yield and 1/4-cup serving. Make ahead: Make the sauce the day before and portion it before chilling. Refrigerate in shallow covered portions within 2 hours and use within 3 days. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: No. The chilled emulsion can separate after freezing. Fridge reheat: Serve chilled. Stir well straight from the refrigerator. Freezer reheat: If frozen, thaw overnight in the refrigerator and whisk or blend until smooth. Serve cold. Option A uses the listed seasonings. For a gentler Option B, omit the lemon and halve the mustard and paprika. For dairy-free sauce, use unsalted white bean puree for cottage cheese and plain unsweetened dairy-free sour cream. Recheck product sodium. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/4 of recipe): 149 kcal, 2.7 g protein, 2.1 g total carbohydrate, 14.6 g fat, 0.3 g fiber, 126 mg sodium. Low-sodium version per 1/4 cup: 94 kcal, 2.9 g protein, 2.5 g total carbohydrate, 8.2 g fat, 0.3 g fiber, 70 mg sodium. Figures cover the sauce alone. Sodium varies with brands.

methods.label: Mini food processor
equipment: Vitamix or immersion blender with tall heatproof jug

steps.title: Fit the blade
steps.text: Use short pulses in a mini food processor for the mixing step. Scrape down twice. For butter, start softened; for mayonnaise, pulse just until combined.
